items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Willie Umford's boys, Percy, Umford, and Willie.

ctx.x: But he was an old professor. Yeah.

And this boy there, his father, I went to the school, and I went to the school, and I picked up clarinet, but I put it down. I went and took two lessons with Willie Umford, the old man Umford, that's his father. Willie Umford's boys, Percy, Umford, and Willie. He played yesterday or day.
